subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should maintainers publish a stable package hotfix for the affected `v2026.6.11` npm dist, or leave stable users on `2026.6.11` until the next stable train?
rationale: The source fix is already on main, but the remaining action is release/package handling with npm dist-tag and stable-user impact that ClawSweeper should not decide autonomously.

options.title: Publish a stable hotfix
options.body: Cut a stable release or correction package that proves the built dist includes the current reentrant store-writer and reply-session fixes, then close this issue with package evidence.

options.title: Wait for next stable train
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical warning until the next stable release ships, accepting that `npm latest` remains affected meanwhile.

options.title: Direct users to beta only
options.body: Point affected users at the beta dist-tag as a temporary workaround, but do not close this stable-package bug until a stable package is fixed.

recommendation.title: Publish a stable hotfix
recommendation.body: Cut a stable release or correction package that proves the built dist includes the current reentrant store-writer and reply-session fixes, then close this issue with package evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is release/package handling, and the latest stable release commit points to this person as the best available release-routing candidate from the observed history.
